steps.name: Epilogue ~ Another Festival
steps.objective: Welcome the visitor who came to see [Shiina].

lines.text: (Two people walk slowly into the magic academy.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Callone, why are you so quiet?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I never expected a search for a lost cat to bring us all the way to the magic academy.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Old Martelli asked me. What could I do? I can never bring myself to leave a lost kitten all alone.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: What's that supposed to mean?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I have my reasons, Callone.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Captain...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: The Empire is one thing, but I understand Libera is also providing financial support to our mercenary company...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Where exactly is all that money going?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Want to know? First, there's something I'd like to ask. Why are you so reluctant to come here, Callone?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: N-never mind. Forget I asked. As long as I don't run into Zephyros or Chloris... Ah, there's a Xerenis Magic Academy student.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Excuse me, student. Have you seen this cat around here? As you can see on the flyer, it has light brown fur and blue eyes... W-wait...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: (Callone spots a female student and stops just as he is about to hand her a flyer.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: There aren't any cats here. Are you sure you have the right place? Oh, you're...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Y-you're mistaken. We're cats looking for a lost mercenary company. No, no. Just a passing cat, no... Whew...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: ...You're flustered, Callone.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I misspoke. Please forgive my discourtesy. But what brings someone of your noble standing here?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: That's what I'd like to ask you, Callone. I'm just a student here. What brings you to the academy? Magic Bureau business...?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: No, it's not that. I...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Then please come back another time. The headmaster and chairwoman are both away. Wait. The person with you...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: (Shiina notices Parmila, who had been hidden behind Callone.)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: You know our captain?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Captain? Ah, the mercenaries...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: So this is what old Martelli meant by finding his cat... Oh, well.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: (Parmila steps in front of Callone with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Long time no see, little kitten. Princess Shiina Dawn Silvaria. You even know Callone? You're better connected than I thought.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: ...I'm just Shiina here, Par.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: (...I have a feeling this is about to get troublesome...)
